messages.subject: App doesn't work after upgrade
parts:
Hi all!

I have an app that was running for a long time, but after an update (shiny-server and shiny) it doesn't work any more...

see below the content of javascript console:

[Error] SyntaxError: JSON Parse error: Unexpected identifier "NA"
dispatchMessage (shiny.js, line 798)
onmessage (shiny.js, line 525)
dispatchEvent (sockjs-0.3.min.js, line 27)
_dispatchMessage (sockjs-0.3.min.js, line 27)
_didMessage (sockjs-0.3.min.js, line 27)
onmessage (sockjs-0.3.min.js, line 27)
dispatchEvent (sockjs-0.3.min.js, line 27)
onchunk (sockjs-0.3.min.js, line 27)
emit (sockjs-0.3.min.js, line 27)
onreadystatechange (sockjs-0.3.min.js, line 27)

shiny version 0.9.1
shiny-server v1.1.0.10000
Node.js v0.10.21
Ubuntu 12.04.4 LTS

Thanks in advance.

Marcio Nicolau

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: App doesn't work after upgrade
parts:
One possibility that NA can occur is when the WebSocket message
containing multi-byte characters could not be converted to an
appropriate encoding. This is very likely to be the consequence of the
locale bug in Shiny Server, which we have fixed recently. Please test
it if possible:
https://s3.amazonaws.com/rstudio-shiny-server-os-build/ubuntu-12.04/x86_64/shiny-server-1.2.0.355-amd64.deb
Thanks!

Regards,
Yihui
